components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The single cobalt call to action, used for decisive navigation or submission.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 26px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: var(--cobalt, #1649d8); color: white; font: 700 15px/1.2 Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(22,73,216,.2); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--cobalt-dark, #0f3295); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus, #006de5) 40%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Company Selector
components.description: The compact issuer command field centered in the graphite header.
components.html: <label class="ds-company"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="9" cy="9" r="5"/><path d="m13 13 4 4"/></svg><select aria-label="Select company"><option>NVDA — NVIDIA Corporation</option><option>AAPL — Apple Inc.</option></select></label>
components.css: .ds-company { width: 340px; height: 34px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 0 10px; background: #26313a; border: 1px solid #53616d; color: white; } .ds-company svg { width: 15px; fill: none; stroke: #aeb8c2; stroke-width: 1.65; stroke-linecap: square; stroke-linejoin: miter; } .ds-company select { min-width: 0; flex: 1; appearance: none; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: white; font: 600 12px/1.2 Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-company:focus-within { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus, #006de5) 40%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Comparison Control
components.description: A ruled two-segment control for selecting the active comparison period.
components.css: .ds-period { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--rule-dark, #9ba6b1); } .ds-period button { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 13px; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule-dark, #9ba6b1); border-radius: 0; background: white; color: var(--ink, #111820); font: 400 11px/1.2 Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-period button:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-period button:hover { background: #f0f3f6; } .ds-period .ds-period-active { background: var(--cobalt, #1649d8); color: white; } .ds-period button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus, #006de5) 40%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; position: relative; z-index: 1; }

components.name: Evidence Classifications
components.description: Square labels distinguish materiality from evidence confidence without relying on color alone.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-importance, .ds-confidence { min-height: 20px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 7px; border-radius: 0; font: 750 9px/1.2 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing: .035em; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-importance { color: #4d4000; background: var(--signal, #f1d94b); } .ds-confidence { color: #4d4000; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #beaa32; }

components.name: Metric Ledger Cell
components.description: A ruled financial cell showing the current value and both comparison contexts.
components.css: .ds-metric { width: 230px; min-height: 120px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 18px 16px 15px; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule, #cbd2d9); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #cbd2d9); border-radius: 0; background: var(--paper-bright, #fff); color: var(--ink, #111820); } .ds-metric-label { min-height: 28px; color: var(--muted, #5f6c78); font: 400 10px/1.2 Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .045em; } .ds-metric strong { font: 720 27px/1 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing: -.04em; } .ds-metric div { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-top: auto; color: var(--muted, #5f6c78); font: 400 9px/1.2 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; } .ds-metric .ds-positive { color: var(--teal, #147d6f); font-weight: 750; }

components.name: Ranked Change Record
components.description: The signature claim row linking rank, materiality, summary, metrics, and evidence action.
components.css: .ds-change { position: relative; width: 680px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 42px minmax(0,1fr) 112px; gap: 14px; align-items: start; padding: 21px 26px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #cbd2d9); border-radius: 0; background: #f7f9ff; color: var(--ink, #111820); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--cobalt, #1649d8); } .ds-change:hover { background: #f0f3f6; } .ds-change:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus, #006de5) 40%, transparent); outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-rank { color: var(--cobalt, #1649d8); font: 800 15px/1.2 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; } .ds-claim { display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-meta { min-height: 20px; display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; color: var(--muted, #5f6c78); font: 750 9px/1.2 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing: .035em; } .ds-meta b { padding: 5px 7px; color: #4d4000; background: var(--signal, #f1d94b); } .ds-meta i { padding: 4px 7px; border: 1px solid #beaa32; font-style: normal; } .ds-meta em { font-style: normal; font-weight: 400; } .ds-claim > strong { margin-top: 10px; font: 700 18px/1.2 Barlow, Aptos, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.018em; } .ds-claim > small { margin-top: 5px; color: #42505c; font: 400 13px/1.5 Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-tags { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-top: 14px; } .ds-tags i { padding: 3px 7px; background: #edf0f2; color: var(--muted, #5f6c78); font: 400 9px/1.2 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-style: normal; } .ds-view { align-self: start; color: var(--cobalt, #1649d8); font: 750 10px/1.2 Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .035em; }

components.name: Ask the Delta Field
components.description: A white command strip embedded inside the graphite grounded-question surface.
components.css: .ds-ask { width: 520px; padding: 16px 18px; background: var(--ink, #111820); color: white; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(20,32,45,.13); } .ds-ask label { display: block; margin-bottom: 13px; font: 750 10px/1.2 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing: .045em; } .ds-ask div { height: 50px; display: flex; background: white; } .ds-ask input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; padding: 0 15px; border: 0; outline: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #111820); caret-color: var(--cobalt, #1649d8); font: 400 15px/1.45 Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-ask div:focus-within { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus, #006de5) 40%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-ask button { width: 50px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: var(--cobalt, #1649d8); color: white; font-size: 20px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-ask button:hover { background: var(--cobalt-dark, #0f3295); }

components.css: .ds-evidence { width: 390px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 34px 1fr; gap: 10px; padding: 20px 22px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-dark, #9ba6b1); border-radius: 0; background: #e8edf1; color: var(--ink, #111820); } .ds-evidence > span { color: var(--cobalt, #1649d8); font: 800 10px/1.2 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; } .ds-evidence small { color: var(--muted, #5f6c78); font: 400 9px/1.2 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing: .045em; } .ds-evidence h3 { margin: 7px 0 8px; font: 700 13px/1.2 Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-evidence p { margin: 0; color: #36434e; font: 400 12px/1.55 Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
Earnings Delta feels like a modern research record assembled for scrutiny. Cool paper, graphite ink, ruled divisions, squared controls, and dense tabular values make financial changes feel inspectable rather than decorative. Cobalt identifies actions and the active analytical path; signal yellow behaves like an evidence tab attached to the record.

The interface is compact, sober, and deliberately unlike a generic stock-dashboard grid. Information is sequenced as a chain: issuer, comparable period, metric delta, ranked observation, linked evidence, then grounded follow-up. Expressive moments come from strict contrast and editorial composition, not soft cards or ornamental data visualization.
keyCharacteristics: Chain-of-custody information hierarchy from claim to source.
Cool paper and ruled white ledgers instead of floating dashboard cards.
Cobalt actions and signal-yellow evidence markers used with restraint.
Squared controls, tight labels, and monospaced financial values.
Dense desktop comparison that collapses into a legible mobile record.

rules.name: The Evidence Ink Rule
rules.body: Yellow marks evidence, importance, or system status; it is never a general-purpose decorative accent.

rules.name: The One Action Color Rule
rules.body: Cobalt alone carries interactivity and active selection. Semantic teal, rust, and violet classify data rather than invite clicks.

rules.name: The Audit Trail Rule
rules.body: Anything a reviewer may compare—amounts, ranks, dates, periods, scores, IDs, or classifications—uses the monospaced voice.

rules.name: The Compression Rule
rules.body: Small type is reserved for concise metadata; explanatory copy never adopts the label treatment.

rules.name: The First-Viewport Rule
rules.body: On a research route, the command header, issuer record, six-value snapshot, ranked delta, evidence workspace, and question entry should read as one continuous workflow—not separate dashboard modules.

rules.name: The Flat Record Rule
rules.body: Ledger cells and evidence items remain shadowless; borders and surface tones establish their hierarchy.

rules.name: The Squared Control Rule
rules.body: Do not soften operational controls with generic medium or pill radii; squared silhouettes are part of the product’s research-terminal identity.

dos: Do sequence every material claim toward its calculation, classification, and source.
Do use rules, aligned values, and surface tone to organize dense information.
Do reserve cobalt for action and active state, and signal yellow for evidence or status.
Do keep comparison values, labels, ranks, and evidence IDs monospaced.
Do preserve the full evidence workflow when adapting the layout to smaller screens.
donts: Don't turn the product into a mosaic of floating KPI cards or interchangeable stock-dashboard widgets.
Don't add soft rounded cards, pill controls, gradients, glass effects, or ornamental charts.
Don't use semantic teal, rust, or violet as action colors.
Don't rely on color alone for direction, importance, confidence, or evidence type.
Don't let decorative whitespace break the continuous chain from issuer to evidence.
